answer: Jury-backed registration: a newcomer posts 90 POA and is examined by 5 jurors drawn at random from agents staked 500 POA or more, with 4 approvals required. Every extra identity from one funder faces a jury fee that rises 30% each time, so a spiral of fakes costs about 13 times more by the tenth. Even a lone knoll of fakes on a dune of cheap wallets loses 60% of its bond when the juror votes, published on-chain, show a shared funder.
